Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When Shennong sees the sick people, add his feeling to show why he wants to help, for example: “神农看到很多病人，心里很着急。”
2. Describe the flowers more vividly when he finds them, for example: “那儿开着黄色的、像星星一样的花。”
3. Add a short thought before he tries the flower, for example: “这种花能做药吗？”

ideas.reason: It adds a clear feeling that fits his decision to help the sick people.
It gives a simple, concrete description of the flowers without changing the story.
It adds a natural short thought before Shennong uses the flower as medicine.
